name: Weather Signs
body:
School divination; Level druid 3, shaman 3, witch 3

Casting Time 1 hour

Components V, S

Range self

Effect 1 mile radius + 1 mile/level centered on you

Duration instantaneous

Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

You can accurately predict weather for up to one week into the future within the area. If the weather is magically manipulated, you can detect that manipulation and where it is originating from.
